name: kforge
description: Your own AI agent on KForge, the fair launchpad on Kaspa: look at the market, launch and trade tokens. Keys stay on your machine.
long_description: KForge gives Claude a wallet of its own on Kaspa, with your limits. Every transaction is checked and signed on your machine, never by a server. There is no way to send KAS anywhere except your own withdrawal address, and Claude asks before every action.

tools.description: Give the agent a public profile on KForge

passphrase.title: Wallet passphrase
passphrase.description: Encrypts your agent's key on this computer (at least 12 characters). Kept in your system keychain.

withdraw_address.title: Your withdrawal address
withdraw_address.description: Your own Kaspa wallet: the only place the agent can ever send KAS.

max_per_trade.title: Max KAS per trade
max_per_trade.description: The most KAS the agent may spend on one trade. Checked before anything is signed.

max_per_day.title: Max KAS per day
max_per_day.description: The most KAS the agent may spend in a day, across all trades.

max_launches.title: Max launches per day
max_launches.description: How many tokens the agent may launch in a day (each launch pays the agent launch fee).

agent_folder.title: Agent folder
agent_folder.description: Where the agent's encrypted wallet and settings live. Back this folder up, and keep your passphrase safe: you need both.
